name: Tama Lakes Track
why: From Whakapapa past Taranaki Falls across tussock to Tama Saddle, between Ruapehu and Ngauruhoe, above two crater lakes.
book: Free, no permit. Starts at Whakapapa Village on SH48, on the Taranaki Falls track 100 m below the visitor centre.
water: No water on the track: carry it. Do not touch or swim in the lakes.
dangers: Alpine weather: strong wind, rain and fast temperature changes, even in summer.
The side route to Upper Tama Lake is unformed, loose and exposed: in winter it needs ice axe and crampons.
No tracks down to the lakes: the gullies are steep and unstable.
turnaround: Turn back if low cloud covers Tama Saddle; skip the Upper Tama ridge in wind or cloud.

points.name: Whakapapa Village

points.name: Taranaki Falls
points.note: A 20 m fall over an old lava flow; the lower track goes to its base.

points.name: Lower Tama Lake
points.note: The end of the track on Tama Saddle above Lower Tama Lake, with Ngauruhoe and Ruapehu on either side.
